summary: U.S. Central Command concluded a five-hour wave of strikes against Iranian military targets across six locations including Bushehr, Chabahar, and Bandar Abbas, aiming to degrade coastal defense and drone capabilities. Simultaneous explosions were reported at Iran's Qeshm Island, Andimeshk, and near the Kish power plant, while Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz open to all shipping except Iranian vessels and announced a full naval blockade on Iranian ports. In Gaza, an Israeli airstrike killed a senior Hamas security commander and six operatives in Jabalia, and Israeli artillery struck southern Lebanon.

sections.executive_summary: U.S. Central Command concluded a five-hour wave of strikes against Iranian military targets across six locations including Bushehr, Chabahar, and Bandar Abbas, aiming to degrade coastal defense and drone capabilities. Simultaneous explosions were reported at Iran's Qeshm Island, Andimeshk, and near the Kish power plant, while Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz open to all shipping except Iranian vessels and announced a full naval blockade on Iranian ports. In Gaza, an Israeli airstrike killed a senior Hamas security commander and six operatives in Jabalia, and Israeli artillery struck southern Lebanon.

points: CENTCOM confirmed completion of a five-hour strike wave at 10:15 PM ET on July 13 targeting Iranian military sites in Bushehr, Chabahar, Jask, Konarak, Abu Musa, and Bandar Abbas using precision-guided munitions to degrade coastal defense systems, missile and drone sites, and naval capabilities; over 50,000 U.S. troops remain deployed across the Middle East. (Source: @VahidOnline/77052)

Multiple explosions reported on Qeshm Island at approximately 18:45 local time; the area has been repeatedly targeted by U.S. forces in recent days according to Iranian media. (Source: @SharghDaily/171922, @rodast_omiddana/76141)
Explosions heard in Andimeshk, southwestern Iran, far from the Strait of Hormuz; a local resident reported a single blast that shook windows. (Source: @presstv/198708, @rodast_omiddana/76145)

U.S. projectiles exploded near the Kish Island power plant damaging technical parameters; Kish Water & Power Engineering warned of unavoidable temporary blackouts with repair assessments ongoing. (Source: @shin_persian/7838)

Trump threatened the "Mountain of Qom" (Fordow) as a possible target for a "nice big fat strike," describing it as a fortified underground complex near Natanz with tunnels dozens of meters deep protecting nuclear infrastructure. (Source: @pkpoi/143280)

Global oil prices exceeded $85 per barrel amid intensified U.S.-Iran clashes in the Strait of Hormuz; the Iranian rial weakened sharply with the dollar reaching 184,000 tomans, euro 210,000 tomans, and gold coins 180 million tomans. (Source: @VahidOnline/77063)

PressTV reported massive turnout for the funeral of "martyred Leader Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei" attended by Iranian and Iraqi people; Ayatollah Khamenei thanked participants. (Source: @presstv/198721)

Israeli airstrike in Jabalia, northern Gaza, killed Hamas Central Jabalia Battalion security chief Mohammed Marwan Mohammed Salem and several other operatives including Nukhba Force operative Abd al-Malek Abu al-Jabin, Central Jabalia operative Yaman Mohammed Jibril Ubaid, and West Jabalia operative Ghassan Akram Salama Dakas; Palestinian media reported seven total fatalities. (Source: @manniefabian/58788)
IDF artillery struck the southern Lebanese towns of Kounin and Wadi al-Hajir; Lebanese media reported the shelling. (Source: @yediotnews25/132674, @redlinkleb/31288)

Israeli settlers from the "Bashan Pioneers" group attempted to illegally cross into Syria in the southern Golan Heights; IDF troops detained them and handed them to police, condemning the act as a criminal offense endangering civilians and disrupting operations. (Source: @manniefabian/58783)

Defense Minister Israel Katz requested a presidential pardon for Elor Azaria, convicted of killing an incapacitated Palestinian attacker in 2016, ahead of Likud primaries. (Source: @manniefabian/58786)

Knesset passed Basic Law: Torah Study in first reading 63-53, enshrining Torah study as a fundamental value; MKs required to declare if they have family members classified as draft evaders before voting. (Source: @pkpoi/143275, @pkpoi/143288)

Prime Minister Netanyahu warned Iranian leaders at the Negev Conference in Dimona: "Do not count on quiet if you attack us. Do not count on a repeat — it will be a different broadcast, much more powerful." (Source: @New_security8200/202567)

Trump stated he gave Iran a chance for a deal but they "shot first — a big mistake," and said he dislikes the idea of Hormuz tolls, replacing them with Persian Gulf investment concessions. (Source: @New_security8200/202574)

Israeli airstrike in Jabalia killed Hamas Central Jabalia Battalion security chief Mohammed Marwan Mohammed Salem and six other operatives including Nukhba Force member Abd al-Malek Abu al-Jabin, Central Jabalia operative Yaman Mohammed Jibril Ubaid, and West Jabalia operative Ghassan Akram Salama Dakas; IDF said operatives were gathering to advance attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/58788)
Palestinian media reported seven fatalities in the Jabalia strike; IDF confirmed elimination of multiple Hamas military wing operatives to remove a threat. (Source: @manniefabian/58788)
No other Gaza or West Bank operations reported in the provided messages.
IDF artillery struck the southern Lebanese town of Kounin and the Wadi al-Hajir area; Lebanese media reported the shelling. (Source: @yediotnews25/132674, @redlinkleb/31288)
Lebanese Army conducted a controlled detonation in the town of Al-Haniyeh. (Source: @redlinkleb/31286)
No further Lebanese front developments reported in the provided messages.

Israeli settlers from the "Bashan Pioneers" group attempted to illegally cross the border into Syria in the southern Golan Heights; IDF troops prevented the crossing, detained the activists, and transferred them to police. (Source: @manniefabian/58783)
Iraqi Prime Minister arrived at the White House to meet with President Trump for talks. (Source: @presstv/198706)
Yemeni armed forces claimed shooting down a Saudi Wing Loong II reconnaissance drone over Al-Bayda province in central Yemen during hostile early-morning operations. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82992)
Trump commented on Iraqi PM Al-Sudani: "He is a young man. He is young and good-looking and I don't like that. I'm not happy about it." (Source: @kianmeli1/89057)
Trump stated: "We don't believe we need to have our army there anymore," referring to U.S. military presence in the region. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82995)
Kuwaiti military reported operating against hostile targets in its airspace. (Source: @New_security8200/202571)

Trump declared Strait of Hormuz open to all shipping except Iranian vessels, and announced a full naval blockade on any ship calling at Iranian ports or carrying Iranian cargo. (Source: @yediotnews25/132685)
Trump said he replaced planned 20% Hormuz tolls with investment concessions from Persian Gulf countries in the U.S. after constructive talks with regional leaders. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76145)
White House National Economic Council director expects disruptions to oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz but claims gasoline prices will continue declining. (Source: @SharghDaily/171934)
Unconfirmed report of a missile hitting a Norwegian tanker off the coast of Oman. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76142)
Explosions reported at Muwaffaq Salti airbase in eastern Jordan per IRGC-affiliated Tasnim News. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4963)
Iranian PressTV showed Iranian public reacting strongly to U.S. aggression in the Strait of Hormuz, urging the establishment to maintain full control over the strait. (Source: @presstv/198720)

sections.threat_assessment: The U.S. strike wave represents a significant escalation in direct kinetic action against Iranian military infrastructure across multiple provinces, signaling a shift from limited retaliation to systematic degradation of Iran's maritime and air defense capabilities. Iran's reported explosions at Qeshm, Andimeshk, and Kish — coupled with CENTCOM's stated targeting of coastal defense and drone sites — suggest the campaign is ongoing and expanding geographically. Trump's declaration of a selective blockade on Iranian shipping while keeping the strait open to others creates a new maritime enforcement regime that could trigger confrontations with Iranian naval assets or proxy forces. The simultaneous Israeli operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and the Golan indicate a coordinated multi-front pressure campaign. Oil price spikes and currency collapse in Iran reflect immediate economic warfare effects that may destabilize the regime internally.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are navigating a delicate balance: Kuwait actively engaging hostile targets in its airspace demonstrates direct involvement, while Trump's replacement of Hormuz tolls with Persian Gulf investment concessions suggests a burden-sharing arrangement. The White House's expectation of shipping disruptions yet declining gasoline prices indicates confidence in alternative supply routes or strategic reserves. Iraqi PM's White House visit amid U.S. strikes on Iran places Baghdad in a precarious diplomatic position. Yemeni forces' downing of a Saudi drone shows the conflict's expansion into the Red Sea theater. Iranian public demonstrations supporting strait control reflect regime mobilization efforts, but the rial's collapse to 184,000 tomans per dollar signals severe domestic economic distress that could constrain Tehran's strategic options.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of U.S. strikes on six Iranian locations, Israeli strikes in Gaza and Lebanon, and Gulf state military activity within a 24-hour window suggests a synchronized operational tempo. CENTCOM's specific mention of targeting "coastal defense systems, missile and drone sites, and naval capabilities" aligns with the reported explosions at Qeshm (strategic island near Hormuz), Andimeshk (inland military infrastructure), and Kish (power plant near shipping lanes). Trump's threat against Fordow indicates potential next-phase targeting of deeply buried nuclear facilities. The Norwegian tanker report, if confirmed, would mark the first commercial shipping casualty since the blockade announcement. Intelligence should monitor for Iranian retaliatory options including proxy attacks on U.S. bases, missile launches at Gulf infrastructure, or Strait mining operations. The settlers' Syria incursion attempt reveals ongoing Israeli domestic pressure for territorial expansion that could complicate northern front management.
